Product Features

  • Luxurious, modern sofa for the living room: Total dimensions: 202 cm× 137 cm× 80 cm. It is ideal for many rooms, such as living room, bedroom and office
  • Two Cup Holders: You can place your cups on either side of the sofa, so you can drink coffee, water, and other beverages without getting up. The ribbed design of the cup holder increases the stability of the cup and prevents it from tipping over.
  • 2 Built-in USB Ports & 1 Type-C: For added comfort and convenience, this L-shaped free-connectable sofa has two built-in USB charging ports and 1 Type-C port, so you can conveniently charge your electronic devices on the sofa.
  • Freely combinable footstool: This corner sofa comes with a freely combinable footstool that can be flexibly adapted to your needs. This creates a free-standing corner sofa or L-sofa.
  • Note: The sofa has been compressed and shrinks after disassembly. That's normal. You need to use a hair dryer and expose the sofa to the sun until it is fluffy again.
  • Comfortable sofa: This small sofa stands out for its high-density foam cushions and thick backrests that provide long-lasting support and comfort. The comfortable linen fabric and high-density foam ensure durability and stability.
  • Load capacity: The sofa is sturdy and durable. The body is supported by a wooden and an iron frame. Each sofa weighs up to 150 kg.
  • Easy assembly: The packaging is divided into two boxes. Simply connect the parts – without any tools. The sofa can be set up in less than 20 minutes. Thanks to this practical design, you save yourself tedious assembly steps and can enjoy your new sofa right away!
  • Transport situation: This product consists of two packages that may be transported by different express companies and delivered at different times. Please be patient.
  • There are 2 pockets on both sides of the sofa: you can easily store books, magazines, notebooks and other items there, thus keeping the sofa tidy.
